description: This Scala source file defines utility functions and configuration settings for integrating Spark SQL with Hive, including version management, client creation, schema inference, and exception handling.

classes.name: HiveUtils
classes.description: Object providing Hive-related utility functions and configuration management for Spark SQL.

methods.name: isCompatibleHiveVersion
methods.description: Checks if a given Hive version string is compatible.

methods.name: hiveMetastoreVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the configured Hive metastore version.

methods.name: hiveMetastoreJars
methods.description: Retrieves the configured Hive metastore jars setting.

methods.name: hiveMetastoreJarsPath
methods.description: Retrieves the list of paths for Hive metastore jars when using 'path' option.

methods.name: hiveMetastoreSharedPrefixes
methods.description: Retrieves class prefixes to be shared between Spark and Hive.

methods.name: hiveMetastoreBarrierPrefixes
methods.description: Retrieves class prefixes to be reloaded for each Hive version.

methods.name: isCliSessionState
methods.description: Checks if the current Hive SessionState is a CLI session.

methods.name: newClientForExecution
methods.description: Creates a HiveClient for execution tasks, using the built-in Hive version.

methods.name: newClientForMetadata
methods.description: Creates a HiveClient for metadata retrieval, matching the Hive metastore version.

methods.name: newTemporaryConfiguration
methods.description: Constructs a Hive configuration with a temporary local metastore.

methods.name: inferSchema
methods.description: Infers schema for Hive serde tables based on Hive metadata.

methods.name: partitionNameToValues
methods.description: Extracts partition values from a partition name string.

methods.name: causedByThrift
methods.description: Determines if an exception was caused by a Thrift error.
